message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In extractFile, the ZipEntry name obtained from ze.getName() reaches the FileOutputStream(File) sink through FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName). The only guard is `if ( !f.getAbsolutePath().startsWith( dir.getAbsolutePath() ) )`, which is an inadequate containment check because it does a raw string prefix comparison without path normalization or a trailing path-separator boundary; entries such as `../analysis-output-2` or absolute paths sharing the destination prefix pass the check and cause extraction outside the target directory."}]}
